article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Sept 14, 2022 (BSS) - Stocks today extended losing streak for the second straight day as the investors booked profit on large-cap stocks.

DSEX, the prime index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE), went down by 50.41 points or 0.77 per cent to settle at 6,487. Two other indices also closed lower. The DS30 index, comprising blue chips, plunged 20.27 points to finish at 2,333 and the DSE Shariah Index (DSES) fell 9.42 points to close at 1,417.
